title: MyNotes improvement execution ledger
comparison_scope: Pinned MyNotes 0.69.0/code69 and official Obsidian Android 1.15.0/code396. No whole-app acceptance claimed.

plan.scope: Search, folders, labels/tags, list/grid, sorting and manual order
plan.name: Find, organise, label and reorder
plan.task: Find an archived body-only match while a folder filter is active; reorder a distant card, then return.
plan.acceptance: Record actual scope, result passage, selected filters and persisted order; repeat list/grid, keyboard and large text. Measure drag continuity only in a new live session.

aspects.feature_outcome: partially_observed: single body-only match in both apps; other search/organisation tasks pending

plan.scope: Notes/Doc, selected text, new typing, headings and Markdown modes
plan.name: Writing, reading and formatting
plan.task: Format the middle of a paragraph, type new text, undo, dismiss the keyboard and reopen the note.
plan.acceptance: Retain surrounding prose, correct style target, caret and saved result. Repeat with large text; compare actual task completion and mistakes, not assertion counts.

aspects.layout_and_keyboard: partially_observed: W02 portrait viewport; paired bold activation blocked in wave one

plan.scope: Complete, indent, reorder, convert selected text and hide checked
plan.name: Checklists, numbering and list editing
plan.task: Insert an item in the middle, indent it, move it past the viewport, hide completed rows and undo.
plan.acceptance: No lost items, wrong-list operations or accidental workspace swipes. Verify numbering after insertion and Backspace exit at an empty item.

plan.scope: Cell/row/column operations, header role and wide content
plan.name: Tables and direct cell editing
plan.task: Edit a long cell in a wide table; insert a column beside it, toggle header role, delete a row and undo.
plan.acceptance: Keep the active cell visible above the IME; no unexpected horizontal jump; restore content and header meaning after undo. Compare the same table, not these unequal fixtures.

plan.scope: Insert, name, select, crop/edit, remove and return to text
plan.name: Images, attachments and inline media
plan.task: Insert a photo, select two recognized words, keep the image, edit its crop, then remove only the intended attachment.
plan.acceptance: Keep source bytes, unrelated blocks and names intact; make copy versus replacement clear. Verify offscreen word selection and explicit outside-tap dismissal.

plan.scope: Display text, safe URL validation, edit/remove and browser consent
plan.name: Web hyperlinks and external opening
plan.task: Add a long URL to selected words, correct a malformed address, reopen, edit and remove the link.
plan.acceptance: No duplicate URL per line, changed neighboring prose or unnoticed external launch. Check keyboard visibility, wrapped fields and TalkBack error announcement.

plan.scope: Connected-note navigation and local/global context
plan.name: Internal links, backlinks, graph and previews
plan.task: Link A to a heading in B, rename B, return through backlinks and preview the target without losing A.
plan.acceptance: Target identity and rename behavior must be verified live; count wrong destinations and recovery steps. No graph speed or link-integrity winner has been measured.

plan.scope: Headings, jump/navigation, find and document context
plan.name: Long-note orientation, tags, footnotes and word count
plan.task: Locate a middle heading, find a repeated phrase, follow a footnote and return to the exact reading location.
plan.acceptance: Verify target and return anchors, heading levels, counts and generated text treatment; do not infer footnote success from a registered command.

plan.scope: Structured metadata, records and filtered views
plan.name: Properties and Bases
plan.task: For users who need records, edit one typed field, filter a view, rename a file and reopen the view.
plan.acceptance: Validate data types, retained filters, note identity and error recovery. No Bases performance, formulas or equivalent MyNotes capability is certified here.

plan.scope: Start a useful note with low setup cost
plan.name: Quick capture, daily notes, templates and unique notes
plan.task: From a cold start, capture a short thought; then create a repeated meeting structure and return tomorrow.
plan.acceptance: Observe time to first saved words, setup mistakes, duplicate daily notes and return continuity. Do not populate fake user content to make the app feel busy.

plan.scope: Visual thinking, embedded drawings versus spatial boards
plan.name: Freehand drawing and Canvas
plan.task: Draw a diagram annotation, leave and reopen it; in Canvas connect two cards, pan/zoom and reopen the board.
plan.acceptance: Evaluate each tool against its own output goal. For common save/return work, preserve content and location; latency needs real stroke traces on matched hardware.

plan.scope: Create/edit a bounded structured visual
plan.name: Diagrams, shapes, arrows and grouping
plan.task: Add two shapes, connect them, group, resize, split the arrow, undo and reopen.
plan.acceptance: Check actual anchor geometry, target selection, retained names and no accidental duplication. Run long-press/context-menu actions with large text and TalkBack.

plan.scope: Open, scroll, zoom, find, annotate and export a marked copy
plan.name: PDF reading, selection, search and markup
plan.task: Open a large scanned/mixed PDF, zoom a distant page, select offscreen text, find a hit with IME, mark a rotated page and export.
plan.acceptance: Compare the original bytes; inspect hit position, highlight geometry and rendered export. Exercise cancellation and a partial destination; private markup drafts are outside Notes backups.

plan.scope: DOCX preview, selection, zoom, import versus original reader
plan.name: Word files and original-layout expectations
plan.task: Open a DOCX with headers, inline images, wide tables and hard page breaks; select text, zoom and create an editable copy.
plan.acceptance: Check original bytes and document return position, compare rendered pages with a suitable Word reference, and disclose any dropped layout/media. Do not invent fidelity from a synthetic one-page frame.

plan.scope: Pagination, selecting, find and creating an explicit editable copy
plan.name: Large TXT and read-only text viewing
plan.task: Open a large multilingual TXT, find a repeated phrase near the end, select across the viewport and return to the prior file list.
plan.acceptance: Measure open/find latency separately from rendering; inspect Unicode integrity, clear selection on deliberate tap, retained page and unchanged original.

plan.scope: CSV/XLSX grids, viewport navigation and data expectations
plan.name: Spreadsheet previews and cached values
plan.task: Open quoted CSV and a multi-sheet XLSX with formulas, missing cached results and wide cells; locate a value and copy it.
plan.acceptance: Compare visible rows/columns and Unicode with source values, disclose cached-only results, retain sheet/scroll position and never execute macros or scripts.

plan.scope: Safe text extraction versus native rich rendering
plan.name: Markdown, HTML, RTF, ODT and slide imports
plan.task: Open one realistic file of each advertised type, inspect text order and unsupported elements, then cancel or create a copy.
plan.acceptance: Record per-format fidelity and actionable errors; preserve originals, reject malformed/oversized archives safely and distinguish external-reader delegation from in-app support.

plan.scope: English/Hindi/Kannada, correction, provenance and loaders
plan.name: OCR, image-region text and scanned-page recognition
plan.task: Read tiny/oblique/multilingual public scenes, blank controls and selected image regions; compare exact expected text and corrected output.
plan.acceptance: Retain source hashes, full hypotheses, CER, omissions/false words, cold/warm latency and correction time. No new accuracy study or training occurred in this report.

plan.scope: Permission, pause/resume, originals, review and speech engines
plan.name: Voice recording, playback and transcription
plan.task: Record varied Indian speakers, pause/resume, deny/regrant permission, play through a headset and correct names/numbers while listening.
plan.acceptance: Measure word errors, boundary losses, time-to-review, seek accuracy and actual audible playback on physical hardware. Verify originals export separately from note backups.

plan.scope: Schedule, rename, deliver, cancel and reopen the intended note
plan.name: Reminders and notifications
plan.task: Set, rename and reschedule a reminder, deny notifications, reboot and then tap the delivered notification.
plan.acceptance: Use disposable notes; verify no stale/duplicate notification, correct note identity and sensible blocked-state feedback. Measure actual delivery under power restrictions separately.

plan.scope: Pinned/recent projection, resizing, share-in and deep-link continuity
plan.name: Home widget and Android entry points
plan.task: Place/resize the widget, pin and archive notes, share text from another app and open a reminder deep link.
plan.acceptance: Verify labels, intended note, no duplicates and return context on real launchers, including large system text. Do not restore widget/notification consent silently during recovery.

plan.scope: Theme, paper, writing lines, large text and assistive input
plan.name: Appearance, backgrounds, fonts and accessibility
plan.task: Switch system theme, increase font scale, navigate with TalkBack and format selected text over a patterned background.
plan.acceptance: Check clipping, announced scope/selection, contrast and focus order across orientations; screenshots alone do not establish 48dp targets or a successful screen-reader task.

plan.scope: Where notes live, extra copies, reconnect and recovery expectations
plan.name: First-use storage, private folders and optional App folder
plan.task: Create notes offline, choose an empty optional folder, revoke access, save again and reconnect without clearing app data.
plan.acceptance: Inspect exact copied categories and pending status; test reinstall/reselection only on disposable fixtures. Never tell the user to uninstall or clear their real library for this review.

plan.scope: Verify output, disclose exclusions, restore without overwriting newer work
plan.name: Portable backup, import merge and full recovery
plan.task: Export a near-limit rich library, exceed the limit safely, import identical and same-ID changed notes, then verify every supported content type.
plan.acceptance: No silent partial success or overwrite; disclose omitted categories and readable/non-encrypted JSON. A complete App-folder checkpoint is a separate opt-in recovery mechanism, not this portable file.

plan.scope: Restore, seven-day retention policy, purge scope and safety
plan.name: Trash, permanent deletion and recovery
plan.task: Delete/restore a rich note, inspect what happens to its audio and exports, then purge only a disposable selected note.
plan.acceptance: Verify the exact affected IDs, Undo boundaries, expiry policy and retained separate data. Never infer crash or power-loss recovery from a confirmation screenshot.

plan.scope: Keep important content reachable without duplicating it
plan.name: Archive, pinning and bookmarks
plan.task: Pin a note, archive it, find it globally, restore it and compare a saved Obsidian bookmark task.
plan.acceptance: Check persisted identity/order, scope labels and no accidental duplicate. Bookmark persistence must be newly verified rather than inferred from its empty pane.

plan.scope: Session recovery, retained history and draft durability
plan.name: Undo, redo, editing history and save feedback
plan.task: Edit text/table/image, undo and redo, leave and reopen; repeat after controlled process restart on disposable data.
plan.acceptance: Verify exact rich payload and history matching the saved revision; preserve current content when history is invalid or trimmed. Never run destructive migration on the user library.

plan.scope: Notes/Doc, switching contexts, Back and layout restoration
plan.name: Workspaces, tabs and mobile navigation
plan.task: Switch between two notes, a PDF and Settings; reorder content near an edge, then return to the initial editing location.
plan.acceptance: Log wrong destinations, lost context, accidental switches and state after restart. Workspace restoration is outstanding until a matching live task succeeds.

plan.scope: Find an action without memorising hidden gestures
plan.name: Settings, commands, quick actions and help discovery
plan.task: Without a walkthrough, find move, undo, export, a setting and one uncommon editor action using touch alone.
plan.acceptance: Observe search terms, wrong taps and help requests; distinguish disabled/contextual/unconfigured actions. Do not use all 205 inventoried commands as a usability success count.

plan.scope: PDF/JSON/text, content copy versus flattening, merge safety
plan.name: Export, sharing, duplication and note composition
plan.task: Share a mixed note, export PDF and JSON, duplicate it, merge selected notes and undo the merge.
plan.acceptance: Check text/media/table fidelity for each promised format, exact source IDs and retained source copies; destination failure must not silently destroy content.

plan.scope: Extractive summary with source context, not generative AI
plan.name: Local summary and text assistance
plan.task: Summarize varied notes with negation, dates and multilingual sentences; check the retained source and decide whether the result is useful.
plan.acceptance: Verify each sentence comes from the source, essential cautions are not lost and limits are clear. No summary-quality test was executed in this report.

plan.scope: Offline processing, opt-in collection, export and delete
plan.name: Privacy, permission boundaries and diagnostic logs
plan.task: Deny microphone, use notes normally, enable logs for a dummy issue, filter/export/delete and inspect the resulting local file.
plan.acceptance: Verify opt-out, readable levels/time range, explicit delete confirmation and exported content minimisation. Security of all native dependencies was not certified here.

plan.scope: Cold start, typing, drag, file open, search, crashes and memory
plan.name: Smoothness, speed, footprint and reliability
plan.task: On matched hardware, cold start, create/type, search a large library, drag a distant card, open a large PDF and recover from a controlled failure.
plan.acceptance: Collect touch-to-visible timings, frame trace, dropped frames, memory and exact failure logs. Distinguish timeouts/socket failures from app crashes and do not publish a fabricated global score.

aspects.timing: Android activity-start milestone sampled only; interactive-ready time not measured

plan.scope: Enable/disable, configuration burden and trust
plan.name: Core modules, community plugins and extensibility
plan.task: Find a core module, understand its description, enable/disable it and identify changed controls; inspect restricted/plugin trust text without installing unknown code.
plan.acceptance: Verify reversible configuration and a stable default note workflow. No community code was installed or executed; unknown plugins and future modules are outside this pinned-version inventory.

plan.scope: Local-first use versus optional cross-device/public services
plan.name: Sync, Publish, account and service boundaries
plan.task: For a future explicitly authorised service study, evaluate offline edits, conflicts, account loss, export and deliberate public visibility with disposable data.
plan.acceptance: No login, purchase, upload or publishing was performed. Conflict resolution, encryption, recovery and cost/value remain untested; an entry screen is not a passed sync task.

plan.scope: View a note as a presentation without changing its source
plan.name: Slides, presentation and reading projections
plan.task: Present a multi-slide disposable note, navigate, dismiss the keyboard, rotate and return to editing; compare PDF reading only as a separate output route.
plan.acceptance: Verify every slide, media, controls and return location. Obsidian landscape was not qualified by its retained audit; no physical presentation run occurred here.

plan.scope: Version identity, offline model claims and troubleshooting guidance
plan.name: About, models, licences and honest help
plan.task: Ask a novice to identify where notes are saved, how to protect audio and how to export useful diagnostics without sending private notes.
plan.acceptance: Observe whether they can explain the result in their own words. Do not substitute long notices or a generated guide for successful comprehension.

paired_observations.task: W01 / create a note containing the shared agenda
paired_observations.summary: Wave one created the agenda words in both apps, but Obsidian saved source had an extra leading #. MyNotes accessibility body and home title versus Obsidian editor/vault readback are unequal checks, not crash-recovery proof. Wave two did NOT correct the fixture: its exact Obsidian body assertion blocked on empty readback. No creation success or data-loss conclusion is drawn from that wave.

paired_observations.task: S01 / find the note by body-only marker cobalt42
paired_observations.summary: Both apps found UX Meeting. MyNotes showed title/type with no body passage; Obsidian showed a passage with highlighted cobalt42. Global search pane setup used the built-in Obsidian command API, so touch-route efficiency is not compared. The extra leading # does not change this body-only query criterion. This is wave-one evidence only. The second-wave raw Obsidian search pass is invalidated: the actual pane has zero results after the body-entry blocker. It is not a successful independent reproduction.

paired_observations.task: W02 / inspect writing context while keyboard and formatting affordances are present
paired_observations.summary: Our Format panel opened and Bold selected state changed false to true. Our body node bounds shrank from 506px to 176px high. Obsidian keyboard and visible B toolbar were captured, but the wave-one selector could not activate B; no successful paired bold-formatting outcome is claimed. Viewport comparison is bounded to the captured states, not equal caret/default font or productivity.

MyNotes route was blocked because the harness sent two Back presses and landed on the launcher before looking for Library. This is a harness precondition error, not proof of missing Library. Obsidian Appearance was opened by settings API, not a measured touch route. Values, contrast and assistive use were not tested. Wave two reached MyNotes Settings and Appearance through the corrected one-Back touch route; Obsidian used settings API again. This establishes entry visibility only, not theme switching or equal route efficiency.

Third W01 exact editor and vault body checks passed in Obsidian before API fixture preparation; MyNotes retained accessibility/home-title checks, not equal storage durability. Third S01 native screenshots show actual results in both: our title/type only versus Obsidian highlighted passage; this is a valid bounded repeat after invalidated wave two. Third MyNotes body node again shrank 506px to176px on Format opening. Obsidian B target was activated on the seeded body, not a verified persisted-bold workflow. MyNotes Appearance opened by touch route; Obsidian by API. No module fully accepted. The reason the same W01 input method failed in wave two but passed in wave three is unisolated; reliability is NOT established.

work_items.title: Show why a body-search result matched
work_items.task: Find UX Meeting using cobalt42, a term present only in the body, and identify the relevant passage without opening candidate notes.
work_items.reproduction: Use UX Meeting with body-only marker cobalt42. MyNotes: touch home search, type marker, inspect actual result row. Obsidian: open built-in search pane by command API, type marker, inspect result title and visible passage, not background document text. Wave one used typed body words with an extra # in Obsidian. Wave three independently passed exact UI-entry/readback, then used disclosed exact public API fixture preparation before downstream probes. Wave-two empty fixture / false search pass is excluded.
work_items.ours: One result is returned: UX Meeting followed by Note. No body passage or in-result highlighting of cobalt42 is shown in the captured result. The query field/keyboard containing cobalt42 are not a result snippet.
work_items.obsidian: Reviewed wave-one and wave-three native result panes show UX Meeting with a contextual passage and highlighted cobalt42. Wave-three result-container checks confirm visible marker passage and result title. API search-pane/fixture setup is disclosed; no touch-route efficiency advantage is claimed. Wave-two pane shows zero results and is invalidated, not an app search defect.
work_items.impact: Without match context, users must open candidates to understand why they matched. Extra effort with multiple results is an expert inference, not measured user completion time in this one-note case.
work_items.severity: P2 expert triage: a missing result passage weakens disambiguation in this sampled state; not a measured task failure. Actual single-result presentation reviewed in waves one and three, with different fixture/network setup explicitly recorded. Wave two is not a paired successful reproduction.
work_items.cause: NotesController.filterNow uses Note.matches to include body matches, but renderUniversalResults constructs a title button plus type/archive/folder metadata only. It does not create a matched-body passage or highlighted result range. This renderer design is consistent with the fresh visible result; no causal patch experiment has yet been run.
work_items.alternatives: The single-match corpus does not measure relevance, search speed, task failure, or user burden at scale. A future configured view could differ. Leading # and default typography differ between fixtures. The installed source/byte identity and raw results are retained; no blanket claim about every search surface is made.
work_items.proposal: Build bounded match metadata on the existing search worker, preserving the current matching semantics: note identity, matched source (title/body/label/content name/diagram), and a short passage/range where available. Render a readable snippet/highlight for body hits and an honest source label for other hits. Reuse the query-generation guard; do not scan full bodies again on the UI thread. Keep grouped Saved notes & Docs, Viewed files and Settings and the 200-result disclosure.
work_items.risks: Preserve archive/global-scope behavior until explicitly redesigned, plain/rich note identity, native accessible labels, Unicode correctness and the user-required floating New note. Do not introduce stale snippets, reveal private content in logs, or silently change search ranking/scope. Position mapping across case-normalised Unicode needs explicit tests.
work_items.acceptance: Retest the same body-only marker on both apps; add same/similar titles, two body occurrences, rich tables/checklists, label-only hits and multilingual/emoji boundaries. Each returned body hit must show an accurate bounded passage and visible accessible match treatment. No false source label, stale-query result or data mutation. Measure correction/navigation effort separately before claiming an efficiency gain.
work_items.next_test: Inspect candidate70 native search screenshot and actual substring spans; verify persistence/opening and unchanged query scope. Continue two-similarly-named-note ambiguity, cancellation/large corpora, rich-content and Unicode acceptance beyond the focused regression. No efficiency or latency gain is accepted from source code.
work_items.owner: Arena coding agent; candidate70 implementation committed
work_items.candidate_build: 0.70.0/code70; Actions-only qualification; not a published or physically accepted release
work_items.implementation_summary: Display-only bounded Body/Title/Labels/Content names/Diagram passage computed on existing search worker for at most 200 sorted results. Original Note.matches inclusion semantics, archived/global scope, query generation guard and grouped sections remain unchanged. Unicode case-expansion offsets map to original code points; bold+underline mark the real substring without colour-only dependence. Long matches get an explicit bounded fallback. No note text/index or diagnostics content changes.

work_items.title: Reserve writing context when the Format panel opens with the keyboard
work_items.task: Keep nearby note prose visible while choosing inline formatting with the keyboard open. This item concerns viewport allocation, not whether bold formatting saves correctly.
work_items.reproduction: Recorded public agenda in the same portrait emulator configuration. MyNotes: reopen note, focus body, capture keyboard, open Format, capture, activate Bold and inspect state. Obsidian: focus editor, inspect compact B toolbar, activate its visible SVG target. Wave-one B selector blocked; wave-two target worked on an empty fixture and is not a paired prose trial; wave-three exact API-prepared body and B activation are retained. Caret, default font and scroll remain unmatched.
work_items.ours: Fresh screenshots show only a short strip of prose above the Format panel. Body node bounds change from [60,277][1020,783] (506px high) to [60,264][1020,440] (176px); panel bounds are [60,476][1020,999]. Bold control selected state changes false to true. These are geometry/state observations, not a failed formatting assertion.
work_items.obsidian: Wave-one and wave-three native keyboard/editor screenshots leave a larger prose region above a compact B toolbar. Text reaches/overlaps the top system-bar area, so this is not a flawless reading layout. Wave-three B interaction observed on known fixture; no persisted styled-text or selection correctness acceptance. Default font/caret/scroll not matched, no productivity ratio. Wave-one selector failure and wave-two empty fixture retained.
work_items.impact: Losing surrounding prose can require closing/reopening controls to retain sentence context. That consequence is an expert inference; no novice task-time or satisfaction study was performed.
work_items.severity: P1 expert triage for a core writing state. Our 506px to176px body-node geometry repeated in all three fresh scripted sessions, but equal-prose comparison uses only waves one/three with fixture caveats. Not incidence, physical readability, large-text or complete-formatting acceptance.
work_items.cause: In portrait toggleFormatting allocates a height clamped between112dp and360dp based on55% of shell height. buildFormatting supplies its own header/options layout; adaptEditorViewport can hide/compact other chrome but does not express an explicit readable-body budget in that allocation. This mechanism is consistent with the observed shrinkage. Which allocation/header contribution dominates has not been isolated by a patch experiment.
work_items.alternatives: Caret/scroll, IME height, window insets, font and title visibility affect context. UI tree bounds are not rendered glyph counts. The larger Obsidian visible region does not prove its whole formatting workflow is better; the first activation attempt was blocked. Landscape rails and large text were not tested in this pair.
work_items.proposal: Prototype an IME/inset-aware portrait layout that reserves a defined readable body area before allocating panel height. Keep the common five inline controls compact and advanced controls reachable through scroll/progressive disclosure; use an explicit large-text/very-short-viewport fallback rather than silently shrinking targets. Treat the three-readable-lines idea as a proposed normal-font target to validate, not an existing measurement or universal promise.
work_items.risks: Keep single A Format, fifth inline Clear, selected-text/new-typing semantics, accessible selected state, 48dp targets, Undo/Redo and safe Back. Do not remove fonts/size/paragraphs, steal typing focus, reopen a dismissed keyboard or undo existing landscape rails. Preserve the actual selected text and caret.
work_items.acceptance: Repeat the same before/after task with fixed caret and equalised note content; record viewport and actual task success. Exercise selected text/new typing, keyboard show/hide, portrait/landscape and font1.0/1.5. Verify reachability, focus, correct formatting, persistence and unchanged note content. Measure interaction time/jank separately before claiming a smoothness improvement.
work_items.next_test: Inspect candidate70 IME/selection/persisted-bold results on all four profiles. Require three visible writing lines in normal-font portrait; inspect explicit large-text/landscape constraints separately. Continue manual font/caret/scroll-matched paired visual review and keyboard-transition/persistence regressions. Do not close the item from a build pass.
work_items.owner: Arena coding agent; candidate70 implementation committed
work_items.candidate_build: 0.70.0/code70; Actions-only qualification; not a published or physically accepted release
work_items.implementation_summary: Portrait panel recomputes from the measured root budget minus visible chrome/padding/margins, reserves a three-line/96dp body budget where space permits, and keeps measured inline-control minimums. Existing scrollable advanced controls, Clear fifth, selection/typing semantics and landscape rails remain. Very short/large-text layouts may not fit three lines; these are explicitly included in pending native qualification, not accepted by source inspection.
